# 888漫步旅遊 · 888travel - Full LLM & API Reference

> Machine-readable specification and guide for AI Agents, autonomous planners, and automation systems integrating with 888travel.

---

## 1. System Architecture & Invariants

888travel is a privacy-first, single-tenant personal travel hub. All data is persisted in Cloudflare KV as a unified store.

### The Invariant Rules
1. **Manual Invariant**: Any segment created or updated via the Agent API is assigned `source: "manual"`. The background sync engine (which periodically scans Google Calendar and Gmail) will **NEVER** overwrite, modify, or delete manual plans.
2. **Category Fidelity**: Categories must strictly match one of the 7 supported values:
   - `flight` ✈️: Flight bookings, airport codes, flight numbers, terminals.
   - `hotel` 🏨: Accommodations, hotels, ryokans, villas, Airbnbs.
   - `restaurant` 🍽️: Dining, restaurants, cafes, food stalls, ramen shops, izakayas.
   - `rail` 🚆: Trains, high-speed rail (Shinkansen, TGV, ICE), subways, scenic railways.
   - `car` 🚗: Rental cars, car hire pick-up and drop-off.
   - `ride` 🚕: Taxi, airport pick-up, Uber, private chauffeur.
   - `other` 📍: Sightseeing attractions, theme parks, museum entries, appointments.
3. **Contingency / Fallback Plans**: Any segment can hold an embedded `fallback` object representing a backup alternative. If the primary plan is full, closed, or delayed, the user can switch to the fallback plan in 1 click in the UI, or agents can invoke `/swap-fallback`.
4. **Data Layer Purity**: Never localize data literals (e.g. store `"flight"`, not `"航班"`). UI and markdown formatters handle display localization.

---

## 2. Authentication

External agents authenticate using an HTTP Bearer token in the `Authorization` header:

```http
Authorization: Bearer rr_agent_<token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

Agent keys are generated in the 888travel Web App (Settings -> AI Agent Integration). Tokens are prefixed with `rr_agent_` and can be regenerated or revoked at any time.

---

## 3. Data Schemas

### Trip Schema
```json
{
  "id": "t_202610_tokyo",             // string (unique ID; auto-assigned if omitted)
  "from": "TPE",                      // string (origin airport IATA or city name)
  "to": "NRT",                        // string (destination airport IATA or city name)
  "start": "2026-10-15",              // string (YYYY-MM-DD)
  "end": "2026-10-20",                // string (YYYY-MM-DD)
  "label": "Tokyo Autumn Voyage",     // string (human-friendly trip title)
  "notes": "Flight booked via BR198", // string (free-text trip notes)
  "timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",           // string (IANA timezone, e.g. "Asia/Tokyo")
  "photo": "https://example.com/p.jpg", // string (optional custom banner photo URL)
  "segments": [],                     // Segment[] (itinerary plans)
  "updatedAt": 1729000000000          // number (epoch timestamp ms)
}
```

### Segment Schema
```json
{
  "sid": "s_123456",                  // string (unique segment ID; auto-assigned if omitted)
  "type": "restaurant",               // string ("flight"|"hotel"|"restaurant"|"car"|"ride"|"rail"|"other")
  "name": "Ichiran Ramen Shibuya",    // string (plan title / business name)
  "address": "1-22-7 Jinnan, Shibuya",// string (optional formatted address or location)
  "note": "18:00 Dinner reservation", // string (optional notes, times, seat info)
  "start": "2026-10-15T18:00",        // string (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm)
  "end": "2026-10-15T19:30",          // string (optional YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm)
  "conf": "RES-889900",               // string (optional confirmation / booking reference)
  "source": "manual",                 // string (always "manual" for agent items)
  "rating": 4.5,                      // number (optional Google rating, 1.0 - 5.0)
  "userRatingsTotal": 2450,           // number (optional total review count)
  "openNow": true,                    // boolean (optional current open status)
  "mapsUrl": "https://maps.google.com/?cid=123", // string (optional Google Maps link)
  "placeId": "ChIJN1t_tDeuEmsRUsoyG83frY4",      // string (optional Google Place ID)
  "fallback": {                       // object (optional contingency alternative)
    "name": "Afuri Ramen Harajuku",
    "address": "1-1-7 Jingumae, Shibuya",
    "note": "Backup option if Ichiran line exceeds 30 mins",
    "mapsUrl": "https://maps.google.com/?cid=456",
    "rating": 4.3,
    "userRatingsTotal": 1820
  }
}
```

### Wishlist Item Schema
```json
{
  "id": "w_98765",                    // string (unique wish ID)
  "from": "TPE",                      // string (origin airport IATA)
  "dest": "KIX",                      // string (destination airport or region)
  "days": "6",                        // string (preferred trip length)
  "month": "November",                // string (preferred travel window)
  "budget": "NT$35,000",              // string (target budget or max ticket price)
  "note": "Autumn maple season flight deals", // string (free-text tracking note)
  "updatedAt": 1729000000000          // number (epoch timestamp ms)
}
```

---

## 4. Comprehensive API Endpoints Specification

### 4.1 System & Diagnostics

#### `GET /api/v1/status`
Returns instance health, version, metric counts, and configured integrations.
- **Request**: No body required.
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "version": "2.8.0",
  "instance": "https://travel.david888.com",
  "serverTime": "2026-10-07T12:00:00.000Z",
  "totalTrips": 3,
  "upcomingTrips": 2,
  "totalWishes": 1,
  "integrations": {
    "llm": { "configured": true, "provider": "groq", "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile" },
    "googlePlaces": { "configured": true },
    "googleCalendar": { "configured": true },
    "resend": { "configured": true }
  }
}
```

---

### 4.2 Trips Management

#### `GET /api/v1/trips`
Retrieves all trips sorted chronologically by start date.
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "count": 1,
  "trips": [
    {
      "id": "t_tokyo_2026",
      "from": "TPE",
      "to": "NRT",
      "start": "2026-10-15",
      "end": "2026-10-20",
      "label": "Tokyo Autumn Voyage",
      "timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
      "segmentCount": 5,
      "segments": [ ... ]
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `GET /api/v1/trips/:id`
Retrieves single trip details by ID.
- **Response**: `200 OK`

#### `POST /api/v1/trips`
Creates a new trip.
- **Request Body**:
```json
{
  "from": "TPE",
  "to": "NRT",
  "start": "2026-10-15",
  "end": "2026-10-20",
  "label": "Tokyo Autumn Voyage",
  "notes": "Trip planned by AI assistant",
  "timezone": "Asia/Tokyo",
  "segments": [ ... ]
}
```
- **Response**: `201 Created`

#### `PUT /api/v1/trips/:id`
Updates an existing trip's properties (`from`, `to`, `start`, `end`, `label`, `notes`, `timezone`, `photo`).
- **Response**: `200 OK`

#### `DELETE /api/v1/trips/:id`
Deletes a trip and its itinerary.
- **Response**: `200 OK`

---

### 4.3 Segments & Fallback Orchestration

#### `POST /api/v1/trips/:id/segments`
Appends one or more itinerary segments to an existing trip.
- **Batch Support**: Accepts either a single segment object `{ ... }` or an array of segment objects `[ { ... }, { ... } ]`.
- **Request Body (Batch Example)**:
```json
[
  {
    "type": "flight",
    "name": "BR198 TPE to NRT",
    "start": "2026-10-15T08:50",
    "end": "2026-10-15T13:15",
    "conf": "BR-78910",
    "note": "Terminal 2, Seat 12A"
  },
  {
    "type": "restaurant",
    "name": "Ginza Kagari Ramen",
    "address": "6-4-12 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo",
    "start": "2026-10-15T18:00",
    "note": "Famous Tori Paitan ramen",
    "fallback": {
      "name": "Kyushu Jangara Ginza",
      "address": "6-12-1 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo",
      "note": "Quick tonkotsu backup"
    }
  }
]
```
- **Response**: `201 Created`

#### `PUT /api/v1/trips/:id/segments/:sid`
Updates an existing segment (`type`, `name`, `address`, `note`, `start`, `end`, `conf`, `fallback`, `rating`, `openNow`, `mapsUrl`, etc.).
- **Response**: `200 OK`

#### `DELETE /api/v1/trips/:id/segments/:sid`
Removes a segment from the trip and records its confirmation reference into `deletedSegs` tombstone store to prevent resurrection.
- **Response**: `200 OK`

#### `POST /api/v1/trips/:id/segments/:sid/swap-fallback`
1-Click Contingency Swap: Swaps the active primary plan with its configured fallback alternative.
- **Request**: No body required.
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "swapped": true,
  "segment": {
    "sid": "s_123456",
    "name": "Kyushu Jangara Ginza",
    "address": "6-12-1 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo",
    "note": "Quick tonkotsu backup",
    "fallback": {
      "name": "Ginza Kagari Ramen",
      "address": "6-4-12 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo",
      "note": "Famous Tori Paitan ramen"
    }
  }
}
```

---

### 4.4 Google Places Discovery

#### `POST /api/v1/places/search`
Queries Google Places API for verified venues, ratings, review counts, and open status.
- **Request Body**:
```json
{
  "query": "Ginza Kagari Ramen Tokyo",
  "language": "zh-TW" // optional, defaults to "zh-TW"
}
```
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "count": 5,
  "results": [
    {
      "placeId": "ChIJb7c_...",
      "name": "Ginza Kagari Main Branch",
      "address": "6-4-12 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo",
      "rating": 4.4,
      "userRatingsTotal": 3120,
      "priceLevel": 2,
      "openNow": true,
      "types": ["restaurant", "food", "point_of_interest"],
      "mapsUrl": "https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=..."
    }
  ]
}
```

#### `POST /api/v1/places/details`
Retrieves detailed information for a specific Google Place ID.
- **Request Body**:
```json
{
  "placeId": "ChIJb7c_...",
  "language": "zh-TW"
}
```
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "place": {
    "placeId": "ChIJb7c_...",
    "name": "Ginza Kagari Main Branch",
    "address": "6-4-12 Ginza, Chuo-ku, Tokyo",
    "rating": 4.4,
    "userRatingsTotal": 3120,
    "openNow": true,
    "weekdayText": [
      "Monday: 11:00 AM – 3:30 PM, 5:30 – 10:00 PM",
      "Tuesday: 11:00 AM – 3:30 PM, 5:30 – 10:00 PM"
    ],
    "phone": "+81 3-6263-8900",
    "website": "http://example.com",
    "mapsUrl": "https://maps.google.com/..."
  }
}
```

---

### 4.5 Wishlist & Airfare Radar

#### `GET /api/v1/wishes`
Retrieves all tracked wishlist radar items.
- **Response**: `200 OK`

#### `POST /api/v1/wishes`
Creates or updates a wishlist radar item.
- **Request Body**:
```json
{
  "from": "TPE",
  "dest": "KIX",
  "days": "6",
  "month": "November",
  "budget": "NT$35,000",
  "note": "Direct flight preferred for autumn foliage"
}
```
- **Response**: `201 Created`

#### `DELETE /api/v1/wishes/:id`
Deletes a tracked wishlist item.
- **Response**: `200 OK`

---

### 4.6 Synchronization & Snapshots

#### `POST /api/v1/sync`
Triggers an immediate background synchronization pass with Google Calendar and Gmail.
- **Query Params**: `?only=gmail` (optional, runs email-only drain).
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "syncStats": {
    "gmail": {
      "parsed": 2,
      "filed": 2,
      "unfiled": 0,
      "failed": 0,
      "remaining": 0
    }
  }
}
```

#### `GET /api/v1/backups`
Lists all available weekly automated cloud snapshots and pre-restore snapshots.
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "backups": [
    { "slot": "0", "at": 1728200000000, "trips": 4 },
    { "slot": "1", "at": 1727600000000, "trips": 4 }
  ]
}
```

#### `GET /api/v1/export`
Exports a full JSON snapshot of trips, wishes, and home configuration.
- **Response**: `200 OK`

---

### 4.7 In-App AI Copilot Chat

#### `POST /api/v1/copilot/chat`
Allows external agents or companion tools to chat directly with 888travel's internal AI copilot with active trip context.
- **Request Body**:
```json
{
  "currentTripId": "t_tokyo_2026",
  "messages": [
    { "role": "user", "content": "推薦淺草寺附近的道地鰻魚飯，並給出備案方案。" }
  ]
}
```
- **Response**: `200 OK`
```json
{
  "ok": true,
  "reply": "推薦您前往「淺草色川 (Irokawa)」，這是一家創立於 1861 年的百年江戶前蒲燒鰻魚老店...\n\n:::proposal\n{\n  \"action\": \"add_segments\",\n  \"tripId\": \"t_tokyo_2026\",\n  \"segments\": [\n    {\n      \"type\": \"restaurant\",\n      \"name\": \"淺草鰻魚 色川 (Irokawa)\",\n      \"address\": \"2-6-1 Kaminarimon, Taito-ku, Tokyo\",\n      \"start\": \"2026-10-16T12:00\",\n      \"note\": \"百年名店，炭火現烤蒲燒鰻\",\n      \"fallback\": {\n        \"name\": \"初小川 (Hatsukogawa)\",\n        \"address\": \"2-8-4 Kaminarimon, Taito-ku, Tokyo\",\n        \"note\": \"色川客滿時的備案，同樣是炭香濃郁的江戶名家\"\n      }\n    }\n  ]\n}\n:::",
  "provider": "groq",
  "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"
}
```
